facts.fact: Bethany 对 Kyle 开讲理论：GlobalVill 设计算法让她沉迷 Public Access Afterworld、给她喂视频，目的是感染她、把她逼疯。
facts.anchor: They made me obsessed! They designed the algorithm that chose what ended up in my queue. They fed me those videos. They wanted me to fall down that rabbit hole because they wanted to infect me. They wanted to drive me crazy

facts.fact: Kyle 向 Bethany 表白：他一直在担心她，承认自己喜欢她、对她有 crush，不知道她是否也有同感。
facts.anchor: I like you. Basically, yeah. I’ve got a crush on you. I don’t know if you feel the same way about me.

facts.fact: Bethany 在书架发现合影：多年前的 Kyle 搂着一名转变初期的 trans 少女；Bethany 问这是不是他妹妹，Kyle 给了肯定答复。
facts.anchor: He had his arm around a teenage trans girl so early in transition that she seemed afraid to look at the camera.

facts.fact: Bethany 指出照片里 Kyle 没有任何影子，而“妹妹”脚下有明显影子。
facts.anchor: “It’s just that you had no shadow,” she said. “Your sister’s got a big shadow under her feet, but you don’t have any shadow at all. In the photo, I mean.”

facts.fact: 趁 Kyle 转身走向书架看照片，Bethany 从托特包里握住 Jules Estrada 的手枪，起身举枪喝令他举手。
facts.anchor: The moment his back was turned, Bethany reached into her tote bag and wrapped her fingers around Jules Estrada’s handgun.

facts.fact: Bethany 开枪打碎 Kyle 面前那碗炖菜（胡萝卜、鸡肉和汤洒了一桌一地），喝令他改吃她那一碗。
facts.anchor: “NO!” Bethany shouted. She fired a shot at the table. Kyle jumped in place as his bowl shattered into pieces, carrots and chicken and broth spilling out across the table and floor.

facts.fact: Kyle 被逼端起 Bethany 的那碗炖菜，在碗碰到嘴唇前一刻假装手滑摔碎在地。
facts.anchor: And then, just before the bowl touched Kyle’s lips, at the last possible moment, he feigned clumsiness and dropped it to the ground, letting it shatter across the floor.

facts.fact: Bethany 把枪指着 Kyle 的头，要他开车带她去“见他的经理”。
facts.anchor: “Let’s take a drive. I want to speak to your manager.”
